metaDescription: Firestone installs and maintains commercial kitchen ventilation in the UAE: exhaust hoods, ducting, extraction fans and grease filter servicing.

blocks.text: A commercial kitchen ventilation system only performs the way it's supposed to if it's installed correctly from the start and kept maintained afterward — a hood and extraction fan that were sized right on installation day can still fail a kitchen a year later if ductwork gets clogged with grease or a fan's never been serviced. We install and maintain commercial kitchen ventilation systems across Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, and Al Ain, treating both halves of the job — getting it right on day one, and keeping it right afterward — as equally important.

Installation starts with assessing the kitchen's actual cooking equipment, layout, and cooking volume, since a system sized for a small café doesn't scale up correctly for a hotel kitchen running multiple lines. We install the exhaust hood positioned correctly over the cooking line, route ductwork to minimize resistance and maximize airflow, fit extraction fans sized to the kitchen's actual extraction needs, and install grease filters to capture airborne grease before it reaches the ductwork.Every installation is tested before handover, confirming the system achieves adequate extraction for the kitchen's cooking volume — not just that the fan runs, but that it's actually pulling the air a working kitchen produces.

A kitchen ventilation system degrades quietly if it isn't maintained — grease builds up in filters and ductwork, extraction efficiency drops, and a kitchen that once had strong ventilation starts running hotter and smokier without anyone tracing it back to the exhaust system. We provide scheduled maintenance covering grease filter cleaning, ductwork inspection, and fan servicing, catching grease accumulation and equipment wear before it becomes a fire risk or forces an emergency repair mid-service.Grease buildup specifically matters beyond just performance — an unmaintained exhaust system is one of the leading contributors to commercial kitchen fires, which is why maintenance on this system isn't optional upkeep, it's part of the kitchen's fire safety.

Ductwork accumulates grease over time regardless of how well the hood and filters are performing, and that buildup happens somewhere most kitchen staff never see or check. We inspect and clean ductwork on a scheduled basis, removing grease deposits before they become thick enough to pose a genuine fire risk or restrict airflow enough to noticeably affect kitchen conditions.

Extraction fans run for long hours in a hot, greasy environment, and that wear shows up eventually as reduced airflow, unusual noise, or outright failure at the worst possible time — mid-service on a busy night. We service fan motors, check belt and bearing condition where applicable, and confirm the fan is still achieving its rated extraction performance, rather than waiting for a visible failure to prompt a repair call.

Ventilation and kitchen fire safety are directly connected — a well-maintained exhaust system reduces the grease accumulation that fire suppression systems exist to protect against, while a neglected one increases fire risk regardless of what suppression system is installed above it. Where a kitchen also has fire suppression over the cooking line, we coordinate ventilation maintenance with that system rather than treating them as unrelated services. See our Kitchen Hood Fire Suppression System page for the suppression side of kitchen fire safety.
A Ventilation Partner Who Understands Fire Risk

Firestone Fire and Security Systems has installed and maintained fire and life safety systems across the UAE since 2007, and we bring that same fire-safety awareness to kitchen ventilation work — not treating it as a standalone mechanical service disconnected from the fire risk a poorly maintained system creates. We handle installation and ongoing maintenance as one continuous service, so the system that gets installed correctly stays performing correctly for as long as the kitchen's operating.
